description: Fork of exp356 (graded upper out_tph [2048..512] + v_tph=256, val=1.3451). Adds out_partition_by_head=true: restrict out_proj input-anchor pairs to within-head only. In the previous partsets test (exp338, uniform tph=2048, val=1.4012 vs exp329_cfc 1.3787 — regression), cross-head info loss hurt. Retest here with graded upper capacity to see if the graded topology compensates, or if partition is still a pessimization.
